• Owner Leases

Three Revolutionary Partnership Models

Pick the ideal structure for your property: capital return, upfront liquidity, or guaranteed rent.

01

5-to-10 Year Capital Lease

We lease your property upfront for 5 or 10 years. You receive the full capital return at the end of the lease period, while Croww furnishes, operates, and sub-leases the home.

  • ✓ Full principal returned at lease completion
  • ✓ Zero repair or upkeep deductions
  • ✓ Institutional registered deed
02

Modified Upfront Lease

Get significant upfront capital without any obligation to repay at lease end. Ideal for owners who need immediate funds for new ventures, family needs, or diversification.

  • ✓ Lump-sum upfront liquidity payout
  • ✓ Zero repayment liability at end of term
  • ✓ Handed back in pristine state
FLAGSHIP
03

Croww Guaranteed Rental

Croww becomes your Master Tenant. We deposit your agreed rent on the 1st of every month without fail, whether occupied or vacant. We take care of all maintenance and repairs.

  • ✓ Rent on the 1st (Zero vacancy loss)
  • ✓ Complete upkeep & repairs covered
  • ✓ Pre-vetted corporate & tech professionals
